arguments.heading: What happened at the argument

Justice Sotomayor asked for a limiting principle to prevent the clause from expanding too far.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of a federal savings clause. It asks if prisoners can use this clause when standard motions fail. The dispute centers on access to judicial review after legal changes.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Prisoners face indefinite detention if they cannot challenge convictions after laws change. The outcome defines the scope of federal judicial review for criminal sentences. It balances finality of judgments against the need for legal accuracy.
